title: More ways for image requests to succeed
summary:
Image requests gained extra fallbacks, section titles stopped wandering, and affiliate matching got more selective.

Image generation gained Dreamshaper and Turbo server fallbacks between Cloudflare Flux and ComfyUI. Requests have more chances to complete when an earlier backend fails, and Dreamshaper no longer receives a seed parameter that caused errors.

The text manipulator now preserves section titles exactly instead of expanding or rephrasing them.

Aura Chat bot by @Py-Phoenix-PJS was added to the LLM Integrations list. It uses the Pollinations API for text and image generation.
